text:
Dear support team,
Greeting routines came up at dawn, so just a quick note

We need the Companion Animal Travel Desk to stay sharp on the boarding notes coming in today. The passenger calls are stacking up, and the common issue is still the same mix of carrier checks, relief break reminders, and handoff confusion at the skyport. Please keep the tone calm and practical when you reply, because the worried travelers are already tense by the time they reach us.

<<FACT F053>> We should not let the new pet routing notes drift into the main queue without a quick review, and I need the team to flag anything that looks off before it reaches the ramp side. If a traveler mentions a pet by name, keep the reply short, confirm the safe path, and avoid adding extra chatter that could create more noise. The safety coordinator is still watching the higher-risk cases, so send anything unusual upward right away instead of trying to patch it alone.

Also, watch the handoff notes between passenger service and the cabin side, since a small miss there turns into a bigger delay fast. If Sofia Kaur or Keira Silva come back with follow-up concerns, give them a clear answer and keep the wording steady. The same goes for Millie if her file comes through again; we want the paperwork clean, the carrier checks clean, and the boarding flow steady. Please treat every pet case as urgent, but do not rush past the details that keep everyone safe.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
